## Financial Performance – FY2025-26

**Audited consolidated results** approved on April 24, 2026 [4]:

- **Full-year revenue:** +10% YoY
- **Full-year EBITDA:** +13.5% (includes a one-time item) [4]
- **Q4 FY2025-26 EBITDA:** flat overall
  - Consumer businesses (Jio & Retail) EBITDA: +14% YoY
  - Oil-to-Chemicals EBITDA: –4% YoY [4]

## Dividend & Annual General Meeting

- **Final dividend:** ₹6 per share for FY2025-26, recommended April 24, 2026 [32]
- **Record date:** June 5, 2026 [32]
- **49th AGM:** Scheduled for June 19, 2026 [32]
- Dividend payable within seven days of AGM approval; no interim dividend declared for FY2026-27 as of this date.

## Recent Developments

- **June 10, 2026:** Reliance announced a partnership with Meta to develop an AI-enabled data centre in Jamnagar, Gujarat [8].

## Analyst Consensus

- 32 analysts rate the stock as **Strong Buy**; consensus target price ₹1,697 (as of June 2026) [42].
